text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Do you know what part of a play 
gets the crowd most excited?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's the moment when catharsis is born. 
The very instant whatever was suppressed 
is set free.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"……While chewing on the bitter taste of 
defeat, I have been eagerly awaiting this 
very day."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What I'm bringing everyone today is a 
thrilling, guaranteed comeback drama!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now then, let the curtains rise...!
